title: ステイヤーズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Stayers Stakes—a graded race at an incredible 3,600 meters, even longer than the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One could even say it's more of a challenge than the Kikuka Sho. However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The longer a race is, the more time you have to soak up the joy of it all. Don't you agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright couldn't be more nonchalant. In fact, she seems almost giddy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Of course I am. But even so, I've dreamed of this day for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for the day when I would run in a long race like the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: Woooow! So this is the Tenno Sho plaque…

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: It's so pretty! I… I might be weak right now, but one day…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If nothing else, at least my heart is prepared for the race ahead. The Mejiros may never have expected much of me, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I always dreamed of the day I would become useful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help but wonder if this mental preparation is part of the reason she did so well with the distance at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she can repeat that result in the Stayers Stakes today…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: To tell you the truth, McQueen, I can't help but feel a little sad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I kinda wanted to watch Bright run in medium-distance races, like I did. See how far she could go, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You really have taken her under your wing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That said, it is not up to us and our sentimentality to decide the path she must run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: With this race, the way forward will reveal itself. Should she spend her senior year focusing on long-distance or medium-distance races?

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps… both.

text_block_list.name: Ryan & McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: I wanted to see her performance as well, in person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Grandmother, you really came all the way out here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Today's race is only a G2!

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: Regardless of their rank, there are some races one cannot miss.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: Not if one wants to know the future of the Mejiros.
